name: Restaurant Counter — Live order feed management
description: Counter staff views incoming orders on the tablet app, accepts an order to Processing state, and moves it to Delivered.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the restaurant counter feed at /counter
Locate an incoming order card for Table 4
Click Accept Order to transition status to Processing
Click Mark Delivered to transition status to Delivered
Verify the order card status badge updates to Delivered and the action buttons update accordingly
